decisions.reason: Because this software is close to the firm’s established automation and data-management capabilities, and the firm has strong in-house R&D plus university links to absorb feedback and refine it, management would likely keep it despite some portfolio-pruning risk.

This product fits the firm’s move toward connected, data-driven infrastructure management and lies close to its existing control and software knowledge base, so a firm with high absorptive capacity would more likely continue developing it than withdraw it.
